en: The postcard displays a sepia-toned view of a quaint hillside town with several houses nestled among trees and rolling greenery. A winding road lined by a simple fence leads toward the town. At the top, distinctive rocky outcrops and possibly a larger building or ruin are visible. The image has a vintage feel, and printed text in German ("Blankenburg a. Harz. Blick vom Schloßweg nach dem Großvater.") appears at the top. A publisher or printer's mark is printed vertically on the right edge.
